label: Nonreflexive giving from a self-edge bridge and an existing exclusion
description: A new conditional support alternative for strict non-self-GivesAt using the existing sourced no-efficient-self-cause node (8b2561cd) and one OPEN cross-sense self-edge bridge. The original Second Way noSelfCauseFromPriority theorem independently supplies that existing exclusion under its already recorded priority premises. The same efficient relation and F.esse appear in the two antecedents; no blanket equivalence with F.CausesIn or time priority is assumed. The new route preserves the direct-assumption option for no-efficient-self-cause as well as its priority derivation. Nothing proves the application truth of the cross-sense bridge, a causal source's possibility, or actual God-existence. The original priority-premise route in this module remains an alternative and now reuses this helper. READING: the bridge drops the history and moment indices, so 8b2561cd is used here under a world- and time-neutral, modal reading (nothing is, in any history, its own efficient cause in any respect), stronger than the here-and-now gloss of its definition 69c0b23e. The source's 'nec est possibile' is a candidate basis for that reading; the attribution of the modal reading is deferred and not checked here. Passing from the being-giving family (158301bc, 88a8fba7, c3c01e92) to efficient causing is done only by the explicit premise 0e961fde on the self-edge; the existing efficient-esse bridge DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient (8934912c) covers only distinct causes.
